title: 30min RPG built using my phone only while I was out of the house
author: Byakko_4
selftext:
I made this 30min RPG without using a laptop, used only my phone when I was out of the house. All procedural except characters (tried making my own but took way too much time), and used image models for a few textures. I didn't one shot this, took me about a week, building only when sleeping or when outside.

  
My very first game, the process is long to get things how you want them, but it's so satisfying to make games I'd want to play myself. I aim to do a more complete JRPG at some point! Tokyo RPG Factory style.

  
[nightwend.com](http://nightwend.com)
